description: Ends a Ready, Active or Paused mail campaign permanently. Unsent mail is stopped, no properties can be added, and it can never be resumed. Mail already printed or with the carrier still delivers. To reuse its steps, create a new campaign. A draft has not started and cannot be ended (campaign_is_draft). Warn the user that ending cannot be undone.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the user confirms ending this campaign for good

name: dealmachine_mail_campaign_end
